issues.description: Reviews report repeated login failures, incorrect connection or number errors, and accounts being logged out unexpectedly.
Reviews describe dissatisfaction with premium pricing and ads, or difficulty subscribing and accessing paid features after payment.
Reviews mention missing songs or lyrics, repetitive recommendations, and unavailable podcasts.
Reviews report downloads getting stuck, disappearing, or failing to play offline, including after storage changes.
Reviews express general dissatisfaction or describe the app as empty or recent updates as poor, without identifying a more specific issue.
Reviews report playback stopping, failing to start, showing a black screen, or playing a different song than the one selected.
Reviews describe confusing navigation and removed or restricted controls, including difficulty finding content and managing playback.
